support.title: Limits of this browser
support.insecureContext: This page is not opened over HTTPS, so the browser blocks the video export and the files it needs. Open the app from its https:// address (or from localhost on this computer).
support.noWebCodecs: This browser cannot encode video, so the final video cannot be exported here: use a recent Chrome or Edge (on a computer or Android), or the desktop app. Editing and the image sequence still work.
support.noPrivateStorage: This browser cannot store the video while it is being exported: update it, or use Chrome or Edge.
support.noSavePicker: This browser cannot save into a file you choose: the video is downloaded when the export ends. Keep room for it on the device.
support.cannotDecode: This browser cannot decode '{label}' ({codec}), so it cannot be exported here. Firefox has no HEVC (H.265), the format of most 4K GoPro videos: use Chrome or Edge, or the desktop app.
support.cannotDecodeAudio: This browser cannot decode the sound of '{label}' ({codec}): that part is exported silent.
support.cannotEncodeVideo: This browser cannot encode {codec} at {size} on this device: the video is encoded as H.264 instead.
support.cannotEncodeAny: This browser cannot encode video at {size} on this device: choose a smaller resolution, or use the desktop app.
support.cannotEncodeAac: This browser cannot encode AAC sound: it is encoded as Opus, which some video editors cannot read.
support.cannotEncodeAudio: This browser cannot encode sound: the video is exported without it.
support.eightBitOnly: Browsers export 8-bit SDR (Rec.709): the 10-bit and HDR settings need the desktop app.
